title: A small Pentagon group dealt with the tall whites, whose base was like a foreign embassy

tellings.quote: The Pentagon had a tiny handful of people that knew they that interacted with them.

plain: Charles Hall, who says he served as an Air Force weather observer on the Nellis and Indian Springs ranges in the Nevada desert in the 1960s, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he spent years around beings he calls the tall whites: tall, pale, non-human visitors living at a base there. He says only a tiny handful of people at the Pentagon, the US military's headquarters, knew about them and dealt with them, and that their base was treated like a foreign embassy. If true, it would mean the US government kept a quiet, diplomatic relationship with aliens.
